basics.name: Marin Bricq
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate
basics.summary: Ph.D. Candidate in Mechanical Engineering specializing in collaborative robotics, bio-engineering, and active inference. Experienced in bridging embedded systems (C, Rust) with high-level robotics simulations, with a strong focus on human-AI shared control paradigms, computer vision pipelines, and soft exosuit design.

work.name: Logitech
work.summary: 6-month internship on embedded software in C running on wireless devices. Ensured multiple devices kept a tight time synchronization to communicate information.

work.name: Politecnico di Milano
work.summary: M.Sc. Thesis Co-Supervision: Co-supervised multiple master's thesis projects (including students Francesco, Solayman, and Alessandro), mentoring them throughout the research process.
highlights: Healthcare Robotics (Prof. Gandolla): Provided theoretical lessons and hands-on laboratories to students of Humanitas University (2026).

work.name: Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL)
work.summary: Tutor at the Dept. of Micro-Engineering.
highlights: Electronique I & II (Prof. Koukab): Provided hands-on lab assistance and guided students through practical exercises (2024).
Image Processing II (Prof. Unser): Supervised weekly exercise sessions, clarifying theoretical concepts and assignment requirements (2024).
Systèmes logiques (Prof. Schmid): Mentored students and provided technical supervision throughout their semester-long project development (2023).
ICC (Prof. Boulic): Supervised and guided students during exercise sessions (2023).
Systèmes électriques et électroniques I & II (Prof. Guiducci): Provided hands-on lab instruction and technical support (2022).

volunteer.summary: Founded the association to facilitate student biosensing projects.
highlights: Previously part of the SensUs EPFL 2023 team (under Prof. Altug): developed a Python app for sensor communication and signal processing for a TBI biosensor.

volunteer.position: Section Head (Ingénieur e s Engagé e s)
volunteer.summary: Led the section promoting ecological prospects and sustainability visibility for engineers at EPFL.
